title: Observe destination-owned acknowledgement without fabricating receipt or acceptance
goal: Periodically observe a destination-owned acknowledgement record, preserve pending state when absent or unreachable, and advance only when schema, repository identity, candidate state, and source digests validate.
acceptance_criteria: absence or unreachable destination remains PENDING_DESTINATION_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
no destination receipt or acceptance is fabricated
observed acknowledgement matches required schema and repository identities
notification and envelope digests match source records
acknowledgement cannot grant destination acceptance production installation or autonomous execution authority
workflow records state changes automatically and requires no manual action
